headline: General Electric (GE) Stock Could Be 13% Above Fair Value Following Hybrid Electric Flight News
summary: General Electric stock has delivered a very large 5 year return. However, at around US$353.73 per share the valuation checks are cautious, with the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate pointing to a premium while market multiples look closer to fair and the overall value score is low.
